args.title: Operator decision on exact bilingual catalogue commission terms
args.detail: Reuse any recorded operator decision for terms SHA-256 449856ff717c44da65c951b67732f916971c35fee3d4c98642d1cd3b2002ee9e. The decision packet is products/services/catalogue-commission-terms/terms-en-fr.md with acceptance-crosswalk.json. Approve or decline this exact fixed-scope proposal, including the provisional CAD 60 price. Until approval is evidenced, use the nonbinding clarification in products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad/operator-reply-packet.json for an explicit commission inquiry. An eligible request, buyer confirmation and administrative acceptance remain separate prerequisites. Deposit attestation and Treasury posting require separate evidence. This decision does not govern the existing free diagnostic or item 4 send-or-decline handoff.
args.expected_gain: An operator-approved quote can be offered promptly when a real eligible catalogue commission inquiry arrives.

description: The completed bilingual catalogue terms give the operator one exact proposal to approve or decline. The fictional rehearsal supports style-level duplicate-image reporting and the proposed acceptance check. CAD 60 remains an unvalidated price. Approval of this version would let the operator quote an eligible commission, which would still require buyer confirmation and administrative acceptance. The existing item 4 send-or-decline handoff and free diagnostic intake can proceed independently. Commercial feedback is available but contains five unclassified sources and no classified requests, so demand remains inconclusive. A redacted send receipt, an attributable eligible inquiry, or an operator decision on the exact terms would change the next action. Treasury remains UNFUNDED with zero verified revenue.
